Nazari sits in three-quarter view at right with one hand relaxed on a mouse and other resting near keyboard. Farah stands just behind and beside her, pointing with naturally held pen at the fixed scaler rule on their shared display and giving Nazari a small knowing smile. Nazari looks toward Farah with a dry raised eyebrow. Both look engaged in work/eachother, no camera gaze. Two arms each and five natural digits, all shoulders-elbows-wrists connected plausibly. No tablet or cards held toward audience.
The monitor is at image left and faces diagonally toward both characters at right and our camera on their operator side. Clear physical screen front visible to both. Perspective-correct information is displayed as a useful work log:
"Scaling for the 11-feature model"
Three separated rows:
"Training rows" then "Fit mean and scale"
"Validation and test" then "Reuse training statistics"
"Inference" then "Reuse training statistics"
Small footer "Same feature order in every row"
Use concise legible typography and simple row grouping only. Exactly this scientifically correct lesson content, no randomwaves, no inventedpercentages, no spurious accuracy claim. Every row's baselines, verticals and borders follow monitor-plane perspective and remain inside bezel.
Scene artwork, not a lesson slide: faces/actions central, screen readable enough, roomdepth, tools, secondary surfaces. Palette muted charcoal/gray, sagegreen#6BAA8A screenink, agedbrass#A89060 trim, small warm pendantpool, no neon green or amberwash, no plants.
